tool.description: Search the web through a SearXNG instance and get the top results (title, URL, snippet). Call it when you are not sure of a fact, when the answer depends on recent events or anything after your training data, or when the user asks you to look something up. Then answer from the results and cite the URLs you used. Today's date is 2026-10-28.
